title: "Invitation from the Tianji Pavilion"
next_chapter_hook: "The Pavilion Master slowly took out a turtle shell from his sleeve. The surface of the turtle shell was covered with纵横 cracks, emanating an ancient aura identical to that of the item in Chapter Two."

text.content: "Night was as dark as ink, the cold wind carrying the unique scent of decaying leaves from the deep mountains. Chen Ji followed behind Ye Qing, passing through layer upon layer of forbidden formation arrays, each step stepping precisely into the footprints she deliberately left. He did not ask questions, merely silently memorizing the layout patterns of the formations—these details might prove useful someday. 'If the people of Tianqing Sect knew I was taking you there, they would probably crush us both to dust on the spot.' Ye Qing suddenly spoke, her tone carrying a playful nuance. Chen Ji said calmly: 'They won't know.' Ye Qing glanced back at him. Under the moonlight, that enchanting face revealed a meaningful smile: 'You're more composed than I am.'"

dialogue.content: "'The Tianji Pavilion is neither a orthodox sect nor a demonic evil faction.' Ye Qing's voice was pressed extremely low, yet every word was clear, 'We are traitors to the Will of Heaven—each generation of members are pieces chosen by Heaven, yet have chosen to flip the chessboard.' Chen Ji's steps halted slightly. Ye Qing continued forward without looking back: 'Do you know why every Tianji Record holder throughout history met a bad end? Because Heaven does not permit anyone to peek at the fate it has arranged. And we—' Her voice suddenly carried a hint of sorrow, 'are here to break this destiny.'"

text.content: "Passing through the final formation, the scene before Chen Ji caused his pupils to contract slightly. A massive underground palace stood within the mountain's belly, its dome inlaid with tens of thousands of luminous pearls, illuminating this space that should have been pitch black as bright as day. At the palace entrance stood a stone tablet carved with four simple yet ancient characters—'Rebelling Against Heaven, Changing Fate.' Chen Ji quickly scanned his surroundings, memorizing the guards' positions and patrol patterns. The two guards at the entrance radiated depths of aura that were unfathomable—at the very least, old monsters of the Hua Shen realm. The Tianji Pavilion's depth of heritage was far more terrifying than he had imagined."

dialogue.content: "'Welcome to the Tianji Pavilion Headquarters.' Ye Qing spread her arms wide, as if introducing her homeland, 'Every person here is a 'rebel' of their respective era.' She pointed toward portraits lining the depths of the palace, 'That one is the astrologer of the Great Zhou Dynasty, pursued by Heaven for attempting to leak heavenly secrets; his descendants founded our Holy Sect; that one is a priest of Great Shang, who prophesied King Zhou's downfall yet was instead cooked and killed—' Her finger landed on a blurry portrait, her voice suddenly dropping, 'And that one... is your father.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's pace finally faltered for a moment. His gaze fixed on that portrait—the figure depicted was approximately thirty years old, with clear, handsome features, a gentle temperament, and a faint, intangible smile at the corner of his lips. It bore a startling seventy percent resemblance to the vague figure in his memories. 'The Chen family has guarded the Tianji Record Fragments for generations. Your father was a candidate for Heavenly Fate in the previous generation.' Ye Qing's voice echoed through the empty hall, 'But he chose another path—joining the Tianji Pavilion, attempting to collapse Heaven's control from within. Unfortunately...' She did not finish. Chen Ji slowly withdrew his gaze, his expression unchanged, as if looking at a painting entirely unrelated to himself."

dialogue.content: "'Every Tianji Record holder throughout history has been branded with a mark by Heaven.' Ye Qing turned around, facing Chen Ji directly, 'Your father had it, and so do you. This mark causes Heaven to perceive every instance you use the Tianji Record's abilities—it will inflict 'Heavenly Fate Retaliation,' until you are completely drained.' Chen Ji's brow furrowed almost imperceptibly. This explained why his body would develop various ailments every time he used his foresight. Heavenly Fate Value... so it wasn't merely the consumption of power, but a chain Heaven had inscribed upon him."

"'So what is it you want to do?' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, 'Completely destroy Heaven? Or take its place?' Ye Qing shook her head: 'Neither.' She gestured, and the great doors deep within the palace slowly opened, 'The Pavilion Master of the Tianji Pavilion wants to meet you. As for his purpose...' She paused, 'I can only tell you—he has been waiting for this day for exactly twenty years.' Chen Ji did not move. He looked down at his palm, where the Tianji Record mark was faintly burning. Twenty years ago—the year his father disappeared."

text.content: "Walking through the corridor, Chen Ji saw more members of the Tianji Pavilion. Among them were white-haired elders, middle-aged sword cultivators with fierce auras, and young boys and girls who appeared to be around his age. Every person's eyes carried something familiar to him—a resilience and coldness that only comes after experiencing despair and betrayal. When they saw Ye Qing bringing in an unfamiliar young man, they merely glanced over indifferently before continuing with their own affairs. 'We don't ask about origins or the past here.' Ye Qing's voice drifted back, 'Only results matter.'"

dialogue.content: "'We've arrived.' Ye Qing stopped before a bronze-colored door. Carved on the door was a giant closed eye, a magnified version of the eye on the Tianji Record's cover. She took a deep breath and pushed the door open. Inside was a simple study. The walls were lined with bookshelves crowded with yellowed classics and scrolls. Seated behind the desk in the center of the room was a figure with its back to the door. The figure slowly turned around, and Chen Ji's breath stopped at that moment—the face bore an eighty percent resemblance to his father in memory, only more aged, with countless years of vicissitude carved into the lines at the corners of his eyes. But what shocked him most were those eyes—identical to his own, deep, serene, as if they could see through all falsehood in the world."

text.content: "Chen Ji's hand unconsciously clenched his sleeve. Twenty years. He had imagined his father's appearance countless times in dreams, yet he had never imagined meeting that face again in such a setting, in such a manner. He quickly suppressed the turmoil in his heart, restoring his usual composure and indifference. 'What is your business with me?' His voice carried not the slightest tremor, as if asking an unimportant question. The Pavilion Master gazed at him, his eyes holding scrutiny, anticipation, and a barely detectable hint of... guilt?"

choice.prompt: "The Pavilion Master's gaze lingered on Chen Ji's face for a long while before finally speaking: 'You and your father... are truly alike.' His voice was hoarse and weary, 'My name is Chen Tianming, the seventh Pavilion Master of the Tianji Pavilion—and your father's biological younger brother. In other words, I am your uncle.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. This news was too shocking; he needed time to judge the other's真假."

choices.description: "Since the Tianji Pavilion has a blood connection to the Chen family, it would be wise to first hear what they have to offer. In chaotic times, one more trump card is better than fighting alone."
choices.visible_reward: "Receive the Teaching of the 'Fate Writer' Ability"
choices.risk_hint: "The True Purpose of the Tianji Pavilion Remains Unclear"

text.content: "Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly spoke: 'Regarding power... I need to understand more.' His tone was calm, yet carried an undeniable caution. A flicker of approval crossed the Pavilion Master's eyes. He took a yellowed bamboo slip from his sleeve, 'This is the introductory heart method for the 'Fate Writer.' It allows you to, within a certain range, temporarily rewrite others' perceptions of the future—essentially overlaying a 'false image' on your foresight, controllable only by you.'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji took the bamboo slip and quickly scanned through it. Fate Writer... this ability was practically tailored for him. With it, he could布置 a layer of interference before using Tianji Record foresight, preventing Heaven's Will from accurately judging his true intentions. But the cost was—He looked up at the Pavilion Master: 'What does using this ability consume?' The Pavilion Master's gaze darkened slightly: 'Each use consumes ten Heavenly Fate points. But compared to the Tianji Record's own backlash, this cost... is almost negligible.'"

choices.description: "An 'uncle' never met before, a suddenly appearing mysterious organization—this is too much of a coincidence. He chose not to trust anyone lightly, even if the other party claimed a blood relationship."
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain Independent Judgment, Uninfluenced by the Other Party"

text.content: "Chen Ji pushed the bamboo slip back onto the desk, saying calmly: 'I don't know much about Chen family matters.' His voice was as placid as still water, 'The word 'uncle' is far too unfamiliar to me.' The Pavilion Master's hand froze mid-air, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. After a moment, he苦笑 and retrieved the bamboo slip: 'You're just like him... cautious to the point of being heartbreaking.'"

dialogue.content: "'I don't doubt the Pavilion Master's sincerity.' Chen Ji raised his head, staring directly into those eyes so similar to his own, 'But I trust my own judgment more. If the Tianji Pavilion needs something from me, speak directly. As for blood ties, familial affection...' He paused, 'In chaotic times, these are often the most unreliable things.' The Pavilion Master gazed at him for a long while, then suddenly smiled. That smile held relief, bitterness, and a trace of... release. 'Very well.' He nodded, 'In that case, I'll speak directly.'"

choices.description: "Before deciding whether to join, he needed more intelligence about the Tianji Pavilion's true purpose. Regarding the Eye of Heaven, the truth behind the Chen family's extermination, his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts—these were what truly concerned him."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain Critical Intelligence About the Eye of Heaven and the Chen Family"
choices.risk_hint: "The Other Party May Use This as Leverage"
choices.process_label: 以情报交换为条件试探底线

dialogue.content: "'Before I make my decision.' Chen Ji's voice was unhurried, 'I need to know three things. First, what exactly is the Tianji Pavilion's ultimate goal? Second, who was the mastermind behind the Chen family's extermination twenty years ago? Third—' His gaze suddenly turned sharp, 'Where is my sister Chen Nian right now?' The Pavilion Master's expression slightly tightened. 'I knew you would ask the third question.' He sighed, 'It seems you care about her... more than I imagined.'"

text.content: "The Pavilion Master was silent for a long while before finally speaking: 'Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect because she carries a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' within her—a key that can open the deepest seal of the Tianji Record. Regarding the Chen family's extermination...' His gaze turned deep, 'On the surface it was the work of the Demonic Path, but the one who gave the order was the then Sect Master of the Xuanwu Sect—which is to say, the current Elder of the Xuanwu Sect, Han Lie's grandfather.' Chen Ji's eyes slightly chilled. The Han family... He firmly etched this name in his heart."

"The atmosphere in the study froze for a moment. The Pavilion Master slowly rose, walked to the window, his back to Chen Ji: 'The Tianji Pavilion's ultimate goal is to find the 'final page' of the Tianji Record—the only forbidden technique that can completely sever Heaven's connection to the mortal realm. But to open it, two things are required: the bloodline of a Heavenly Fate holder, and...' He turned around, his gaze falling upon Chen Ji, 'A 'Fate Writer' willing to trade life for life.' Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That smile carried a hint of mockery: 'So you need me—to serve as that life-trading sacrifice?'"

dialogue.content: "'No.' The Pavilion Master shook his head, his voice carrying a trace of bitterness, 'Trading life for life is the old method. We have now found a new approach—requiring the Fate Writer's ability to cover Heaven's perception of the final page, buying time for the acquisition of the forbidden technique. As for your life...' He paused, 'What your father failed to complete twenty years ago, we hope you will end. But the choice... has always been in your hands.' Ye Qing stood nearby, listening quietly, not interjecting. Her gaze rested on Chen Ji, carrying complex emotions—concern, anticipation, and a sentiment she herself could not quite define."

text.content: "Chen Ji fell silent. In his mind he rapidly calculated the pros and cons. The power and intelligence the Tianji Pavilion commanded were indeed tempting, but their purpose did not entirely align with his—they wished to end Heaven, while he only wished to protect those he cared about. His sister Chen Nian was still in the Holy Sect's grip. Su Qingyao was trapped in the Tianqing Sect. Han Lie's threat remained unresolved. And Ling Yuan, that old fox, was unfathomably deep... In this intricate chess game, whether the Tianji Pavilion was enemy or ally still required time to verify. But he had to admit, the 'Fate Writer' ability was precisely what he needed most at present."

dialogue.content: "'I need time to consider.' Chen Ji finally spoke, his tone still calm, 'But before that—' He looked at the Pavilion Master, 'I have one more question.' The Pavilion Master slightly nodded: 'Please ask.' Chen Ji slowly took out from his chest the turtle shell he had carried with him since Chapter Two, and placed it on the desk. The cracks on the turtle shell's surface shimmered with a strange light under the candlelight, as if narrating some untold secret. 'This turtle shell is my father's legacy to me.' His voice was low, 'What connection does it have with the Tianji Pavilion?'"

text.content: "The Pavilion Master's gaze fell upon the turtle shell, his pupils contracting sharply. His hand trembled as it reached toward the shell, yet stopped mid-air. 'This is...' His voice was hoarse and barely audible, 'The medium your father used to record the Tianji Record's prophecies. Each turtle shell seals a fragment of true history before it was altered.' He raised his head, looking at Chen Ji with a gaze full of shock and disbelief, 'He left it to you... This means that twenty years ago, he had already calculated that you would bring it here today.' Silence as death filled the study."

"Chen Ji lowered his head to gaze at the turtle shell in his palm. Great waves churned in his heart. Father... just how grand a chess game were you playing? Planning from twenty years ago, even calculating this very moment? His fingers gently traced the shell's patterns, feeling that familiar yet unfamiliar warmth. What truth was sealed within this turtle shell? And how far did the chess game father left behind extend? Just as thoughts churned within him, the Pavilion Master's voice rang out again: 'Chen Ji, the doors of the Tianji Pavilion are always open to you. But there is one thing you must remember—' His gaze became extraordinarily grave, 'Before you make your final choice, never let the Eye of Heaven perceive your intentions. It... is always watching you.'"

"As he left the study, Ye Qing walked by Chen Ji's side, lowering her voice: 'Do you believe him?' Chen Ji gave no answer. His gaze fell upon his father's portrait in the distance. Whether to believe or not had never been his primary consideration. He only believed in chips and transactions, in the balancing of interests and risks. What could the Tianji Pavilion offer him? What did he need? Before completely uncovering the other's cards, any promise was empty talk. 'Let's go.' He said calmly, 'I've learned enough for one night.' Ye Qing glanced at him, as if wanting to speak yet stopping herself, finally merely following silently. The luminous pearls of the underground palace gradually receded behind them, yet the chess game in Chen Ji's heart was only beginning to unveil a new corner."
